scenes.title: A boat at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver and offers a ride at first light tomorrow, refusing night travel. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago on the night the bell first rang; her grandmother said the water came up warm.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm floodwater and hymn pages, one marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as his sister Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement, but the search finds no further evidence; Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The fishermen's warning
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick
scenes.summary: The party returns to Gullwick at dusk and visits the shore despite Sela's warning. A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother drags children underwater; the GM attributes this tale to the fishermen.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: At midnight, the underwater bell rings twelve times and the humming is louder than two nights earlier. Pale figures appear in rows on the submerged chapel floor, then vanish when the bell stops; the GM notes the choir clock at three of six, and the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull tavern, Gullwick docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa says she will buy rope and a second lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
